description.fun: Carnivine is a Venus flytrap with a temper. It hangs from treetops in swamps by its vines, looking just like a plant, while sweet-smelling drool dribbles from its open mouth to lure prey. When something wanders in, it chomps down and then takes a whole day to eat it. Its Japanese name, Muskippa, plays on Dionaea muscipula, the flytrap's scientific name.
description.guide: Carnivine is a Grass-type Pokémon based on a Venus flytrap. It hangs from trees in marshes using its tentacles and lures prey with sweet-smelling saliva. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A gluttonous Venus flytrap that dangles from trees.
